description: One human ruling on one schema gap between a source instance and this hub. The gap keys are canonical (see the field description); cutover readiness refuses READY while any reported gap is unruled, or a non-'Not needed' ruling is still unmet in the latest evidence.

fields.description: Canonical key, exactly as the run/check records it: field:{Doctype}.{fieldname} for a column this site lacks, value:{Doctype}.{fieldname}={value} for a Select value it refuses, absent:{Doctype} for a doctype the source lacks, unmirrored:{Doctype} for source data not brought across, unreadable:{Doctype} for a source read the API user is refused.
